name: stereoscopic-image-viewer/stereo-img
title: Stereoscopic Image
description: Display a stereoscopic 3D image from the media library.

src.description: URL of the primary (or only) source image.

srcRight.description: URL of the right-eye image when sourceFormat is 'pair'.

srcId.description: Attachment ID of the primary image.

srcRightId.description: Attachment ID of the right-eye image.

sourceFormat.description: How the source image encodes left and right eyes.

sourceSqueezeEnabled.description: Source is anamorphic (half-width SBS or half-height TB). Unsqueeze when splitting.

displayMode.description: How to display the image to the viewer.

displaySqueezeEnabled.description: Output as anamorphic (half-width SBS or half-height TB). Only applies to side-by-side and top-bottom display modes.

swapSources.description: Swap left and right eye sources.

width.description: CSS width value with unit: px, %, or vw.

borderEnabled.description: Show a border around the image.

borderColor.description: CSS hex color for the border.

shadowEnabled.description: Apply a drop shadow to the image wrapper.

shadowColor.description: Shadow color (CSS color value, e.g. rgba(0,0,0,0.25)).

controlslist.description: Space-separated list of mode-switching buttons to show in the stereo-img viewer. Valid tokens: wiggle, left, right, anaglyph. Leave empty to show all controls (including VR). Only applies when stereo-img renders the output.
